personality_one_liner: A crisp, frictionless calorie tracker that feels like a premium iOS utility, letting the food photography and data take center stage.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards never flush to screen edges; always use 'lg' margin. Ensure sticky bottom FABs have ample bottom padding to clear the home indicator.

do's: Use on the sticky bottom tab bar
Use on the floating action button (Camera)
Use for the bottom sheet header during AI analysis
dont's: Never use on normal list rows or cards
Do not use on form inputs

screens.name: Splash
screens.purpose: Brand presentation with the 'CRACK - Track It First' tagline.

states.loading: Full screen with brand wordmark and tagline, subtle fade in.

screens.layout: Centered logo and tagline 'Track It First'. For dark mode, use the literal cracked plate image covering the background with a gradient scrim.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: User authentication via email and password (JWT).

states.error: Toast or inline text above button for auth failures.

screens.layout: Standard iOS single-column form. Large inputs with labels above. Primary sticky CTA at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Capture user goal (Gain/Lose/Maintain), weight, and height to calculate daily calorie needs.

states.error: Validation error if fields are skipped.

screens.layout: Step-by-step or single scrollable form. Goal selection uses large, touchable cards (selectable with 'brandStrong' border on active). Sticky 'Continue' button.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provide at-a-glance calorie status and act as the launchpad for logging food.

states.loading: Skeleton loader for the calorie ring and food list.
states.empty: Clean illustration (empty plate) stating 'No food logged today' with an arrow pointing to the Camera FAB.
states.error: Error fetching today's log with a Retry button.

screens.layout: Header: User name (left) + Avatar (right). Top Section: Large circular progress ring displaying 'Calories eaten / Calorie Goal'. Below the ring, a pill badge indicating 'Deficient', 'Good', or 'Overeaten'. Content: 'You eat today' list - simple rows with Timestamp, Food Name, and Calories. Sticky FAB floating above the tab bar for Camera/Manual entry.

screens.name: Camera / AI Result
screens.purpose: Scan food, process via Gemini, and decide whether to eat it.

states.loading: Full screen camera view -> upon capture, a frosted glass overlay with 'Processing food...' and a spinner.
states.error: Toast if Gemini fails to identify food, with fallback 'Manual Entry' CTA.

screens.layout: Camera viewfinder taking up the top 60% of the screen. Upon capture, a bottom sheet slides up displaying: captured image thumbnail, Macro breakdown row (Calories, Fat, Carbs), a Good/Bad status badge, and two large buttons stacked vertically: 'Eating it' (Primary, brandPrimary) and 'Not eating it' (Ghost).

screens.name: Manual Entry
screens.purpose: Fallback for when camera scanning isn't preferred; log food by name and calories.

states.error: Validation styling for empty required fields.

screens.layout: Clean, single-column form with 'Food Name' and 'Calories' inputs. KeyboardAvoidingView with sticky 'Add to Log' CTA.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Manage weight/goal settings and view the 30-day track record.

states.empty: Empty state for 30-day record if account is new.
states.error: Standard inline error for failed updates.

screens.layout: Top section: Inputs for Goal, Weight (kg), and Height (cm) with an 'Update' button. Bottom section: A clean list of the last 30 days (Date + Total Calories + Status badge).

onboarding_hero.alt: Aesthetic healthy salad in a white bowl

splash_dark_backdrop.alt: Broken round porcelain plate on black background representing CRACK

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the iOS-Native Clean personality. Ensure the app feels highly functional but crisp and bright, focusing on the data and the food.
Implement a circular progress ring on the Home screen to represent daily calorie intake vs. goal.
For the camera AI flow: transition smoothly from the camera view to a glassmorphic bottom sheet once Gemini returns the macro breakdown.
The primary action (Camera / Add Food) must be extremely prominent. Use a sticky FAB sitting above the bottom tab bar.
Ensure 'Deficient', 'Good', and 'Overeaten' statuses use the respective 'warning', 'success', and 'error' theme colors.
Incorporate the 'crack' motif subtly, utilizing the dark backdrop image for the splash screen if appropriate, or sticking to a clean logo approach in light mode.
For data inputs (weight/height), use clean iOS-style form rows.
